plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Hikvision IP cameras and NVRs (HIK-DEVICE-MIB). It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory, disk usage, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 39165).
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Hikvision device (HIK-DEVICE-MIB cpuPercent, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.39165.1.7.0). The device returns text such as "12 PERCENT"; the number is parsed at collection.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Hikvision device (HIK-DEVICE-MIB memUsed, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.39165.1.11.0). Text such as "96 PERCENT" is used directly; an absolute value with a size unit is divided by memSize.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the Hikvision device in bytes, derived from memUsed and memSize (HIK-DEVICE-MIB 1.3.6.1.4.1.39165.1.11.0 / .10.0).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the Hikvision device in bytes, derived as memSize minus used memory.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Hikvision device in bytes (HIK-DEVICE-MIB memSize, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.39165.1.10.0). Text such as "256 MB" is parsed and converted to bytes at collection.

metrics.name: device_disk_usage
metrics.description: Disk-space utilization of the Hikvision device (HIK-DEVICE-MIB diskPercent, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.39165.1.9.0). Text such as "95 PERCENT" is parsed at collection; devices without local storage usually report 0.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average inbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average outbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: Total inbound interface bytes per second over five minutes, summed from 64-bit ifHCInOctets.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: Total outbound interface bytes per second over five minutes, summed from 64-bit ifHCOutOctets.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: Device uptime since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime.
